title: Replace the independent acceptance-evaluation mechanism: delete evaluator spawning, named-root sightings and evaluated-policy enforcement; the review pair judges acceptance per criterion
outcome: Replace the independent acceptance-evaluation mechanism: delete evaluator spawning, named-root sightings and evaluated-policy enforcement; the review pair judges acceptance per criterion
acceptance: Engram no longer enforces evaluated acceptance at done: the evaluation-policy enforcement, evaluator-binding and named-root-sighting requirements are deleted from the code, not disabled, and done completes on recorded criterion evidence

The review instructions (/review-code, /review-changes, AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md standing approval) replace the separate evaluation with a per-criterion met/not-met verdict from each reviewer of the frozen tree, recorded by the parent. Authority-text edits follow the exact-wording process
TermAl's evaluator/sighting dependency is removed or tracked on a TermAl item, so no Engram or TermAl flow waits on an evaluation
The full gate and a clean review pair pass on the exact commit
